method: One ordinary aerial plus two actually inspected courtyard/tower pictures; current standard viewer PMTiles only. No bespoke archival/survey research.

references.observed: Actually inspected ordinary oblique color aerial: complete high principal U with central tiered tower, long pitched roofs and repeated dormers/chimneys. Attached lower galleries and arcades join curved stables/riding-school ranges around a large open riding court. Rear pale ranges and a circular/domed roof, city and canals need current-map ownership resolution. This older-looking picture guides topology; two separate newer front pictures guide present tower/facade appearance and current PMTiles guides fit.

Actually inspected close contemporary tower/courtyard picture: gray/russet stone main tower, very tall real arched openings in successive upper stages, open gallery at the upper lantern, curved metal roof shoulders and narrow stacked finial/crown silhouettes. Brown/copper surfaces transition to green upper metal; gilded spheres are accents. Main U has white-grid glazing, layered sill/cornice bands, a high roof with dormers and chimneys. No statues,heraldry,lettering orfigures are copied.

Actually inspected wider courtyard picture from a similar front direction,not an independent rear view. Full returned U wings,central through-portal/tower,three main facade levels,white-grid windows,corner urn silhouettes,front gated screen and roof/dormer rhythm are visible. The main court remains open. Ornamental figures/inscriptions are excluded or replaced by original simplified trim.
